Item.name: PCEAV-15K-C
Item.description: Rare example of PolyCorp's External Activity Vehicle designs, while the schematics are now included in almost every fabricator chipset, few have the ability to manufacture the suit. Originally designed for exploration in the 'Abyss', the suit now primarily sees use as a more combat oriented alternative to the standard 'Exosuit'. Gaining rapid popularity in the hands of the 'Separatists' and other unsavoury people. Rated for 15000m of depth.

Item.name: PCGL-26A3
Item.description: Introduced by PolyCorp in the beginning years of the Jovian Disaster, the weapon quickly fell out of favour due to being unreasonably heavy. Chambered in the somewhat underpowered, albeit fast flying 26x50mm cartridge. Proper employment of the weapon requires the use of an 'Exosuit'.

Item.name: PCBD-40
Item.description: PolyCorp's cheapest solution to hull breaching. Use of blast protective equipment recommended.

Item.name: PCHG-18
Item.description: A heavier version of the harpoon gun, often used for dispatching unwanted wildlife, use of an 'Exosuit' recommended. Uses 18mm Harpoons

Item.name: PCHMG-7
Item.description: Standard issue heavy machinegun developed for small remotely controlled PolyCorp drones, while the drones are largely inactive, their primary weapon has seen quite frequent use among exosuit assaults. Use of an 'Exosuit' recommended, uses 7.28x48mm belts.

Item.name: PCRRP-9F21NR
Item.description: Polycorp's less than stellar solution to railgun gunnery. Built on the standard railgun shell, the explosives compartment has been taken up by a rocket motor assembly.

Item.name: Инопланетное автоматическое орудие
Item.description: Древнее орудие найденное в руинах. Оно немного больше чем другие инопланетные пушки.

Item.name: Инопланетное орудие
Item.description: Больше древнее орудие найденное в руинах.

Item.name: Инопланетное тяжёлое орудие
Item.description: Большое древнее орудие. Создаёт огромные взрывы в местах попадания. Оно готово кому-то снести хлебальник.

Item.name: Инопланетная энергетическая граната
Item.description: Странная вещица найденная в руинах, похожа на гранату...

Item.name: Инопланетный клинок
Item.description: Древний клинок найденный в руинах. Когда вы его берёте в руки, вы ощущаете чей-то взгляд.
